role: The skull block: a tile-entity block placed by ItemSkull, whose type lives in TileEntitySkull; breaking drops one skull item of that type, and the wither skeleton arrangement builds a wither.

members.name: BlockSkull
members.note: id 144 static properties (Material.circuits, bounds, opacity, flags) in the generated table; the constructor itself has no body to port

members.name: getRenderType
members.note: render_type -1: no block render, the tile entity renderer draws it

members.name: getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool
members.note: setBlockBoundsBasedOnState's per-facing box (collide.c:skull_bounds) for both the pool box and addCollisionBoxesToList. details-blocks-s1 walks into a wall skull and steps up onto a floor skull.

members.name: onBlockPlacedBy
members.note: Never reached in survival: ItemSkull.onItemUse places the skull with setBlock and writes the rotation to the tile entity itself (place.c:item_skull_on_item_use); nothing calls BlockSkull.onBlockPlacedBy.

members.name: getDamageValue
members.note: The tile entity's type; pick block (Minecraft.func_147112_ai) reads it here, and dig.c:skull_drops reads the same type for the drop.

members.name: damageDropped
members.note: BlockSkull overrides dropBlockAsItemWithChance empty and getDamageValue (the tile entity's type); falling blocks are only sand, gravel, the anvil and the dragon egg

members.name: dropBlockAsItemWithChance
members.note: case 144: the override is empty, no drop on ordinary breaking

members.name: onBlockHarvested
members.note: Its body acts only in creative mode (bit 8 suppresses the drop); survival play never sets it.

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: One skull of the tile entity's type (dig.c:skull_drops). A player head's SkullOwner tag needs a player head, which survival never makes (no player-head drop in 1.7.10). A flow that replaces a skull drops it in features_springs.c:flow_into on the tick's World.rand; the world write's own tail (world.c block_break_tail) leaves the drop to the paths that harvest a skull themselves (liq-wash-s1).

members.name: getItemDropped
members.note: BlockSkull overrides dropBlockAsItemWithChance empty; the skull drops from breakBlock through its tile entity

members.name: func_149965_a
members.note: wither construction; the netherite.oracle.WorldConf.wither hook at the top returns early because world.conf wither = off

members.name: func_149966_a
members.note: only called from func_149965_a, which the wither switch disables

members.name: getIcon
members.note: The block icon (soul sand) is never drawn: render type -1, the tile entity renderer draws the skull (render_skull, te_skulls goldens).

members.name: getItemIconName
members.note: hopper item icon name, client GUI only

notes: The func_149965_a body after the WorldConf.wither hook was read but not indexed member by member; the whole wither build is dead under world.conf wither = off (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches'). lane/idxblocks: the creative bit and player heads are not survival-reachable.
